sourceReview.result: Journal PDF downloaded; model-comparison and Data Availability sections read. Section 3 compares NEMESIS predictions with Voyager/ISS and IRIS; filter-dependent photometric discrepancies are discussed. Data Availability states that underlying data are shared on reasonable request to the corresponding author. No tabulated Johnson V phase-response dataset was supplied by this PDF.

requiredToClose: An independently justified Jupiter Johnson V model meeting 0.1 mag throughout 0-130 degrees. The new Heng/CALSPEC/Bessell prediction has maximum absolute residual 0.15324715572835323 mag, and opposition residual -0.13424954465890337 mag. Do not fit an offset or phase correction to the oracle.

Independent calibrated Johnson V phase-response data or physical scattering models for Mercury 2-170 degrees, Venus 2-179 degrees, Mars 0-50 degrees, Saturn globe 0-150 degrees, Uranus 0-154 degrees, Neptune 0-133 degrees. Geometric albedo alone is insufficient.
Preserve the test-only boundary: Mallama-Hilton equations, coefficient tables and sampled oracle curves must not become runtime or build inputs.
